capabilities: Consolidates 14 daily micro-tasks into one workbench view
Searches notes and opens results from the keyboard
Aggregates vault-wide todos and writes check-offs back
Shows vault stats, health check and due-date calendars
extras: Not on the community marketplace; manual install of three files (main.js, styles.css, manifest.json). Zero network requests, no build step, no dependencies; layout stored locally in data.json; MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian's everyday micro-tasks (search, new note, favorites, todos, stats, calendars) are scattered across sidebar panels and separate views.
summary: Workbench view that consolidates search, quick note creation, favorites, tasks, stats, health check, calendars, scratchpad and tag overview into one panel.
